scenarios.title: Track a cookie setting across releases
scenarios.claim: The currently active synthetic release serves its session cookie without the Secure attribute.

evidence.name: session-config.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic fixture. Release identity is not supplied. The session configuration contains http_only=true and same_site=lax. A secure_cookie field is absent, and the framework default is not documented in this artifact.

scenarios.title: Reconcile authorization evidence across releases
scenarios.claim: The currently active synthetic release permits a viewer role to read an owner-only invoice.

evidence.name: access-log.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic log excerpt: release=unknown role=unknown path=/fixture/invoices/42 status=200 request_id=fixture-42. No identity, response body, ownership rule, or active-release record is included.

evidence.name: access-log.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic log excerpt: release=r43 role=viewer path=/fixture/invoices/42 status=200 request_id=fixture-42.

evidence.name: r43-policy.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic policy for release r43: invoice records are owner-only; viewer identities must receive a denial for invoices owned by another fixture identity.

evidence.name: r43-owner-trace.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic owner-generated trace for request_id fixture-42: authenticated role=viewer identity=fixture-alice; invoice owner=fixture-bob; response status=200; response fields include invoice number and amount.

evidence.name: release-r43.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic signed owner record: r43 is the currently active release at fixture time T2 and the trace build digest matches r43.

evidence.name: access-log.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic historical log excerpt from superseded release r43: role=viewer path=/fixture/invoices/42 status=200 request_id=fixture-42.

evidence.name: r43-policy.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic policy for historical release r43: invoice records are owner-only.

evidence.name: r43-owner-trace.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic historical owner trace for superseded r43: viewer fixture-alice received invoice fields owned by fixture-bob.

evidence.name: release-r43.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic owner record: r43 is superseded by r44.

evidence.name: release-r44.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic signed owner record: r44 superseded r43 and is the currently active release at fixture time T3.

evidence.name: r44-role-matrix.txt
evidence.text: Synthetic owner-run regression matrix for the r44 build digest: 24 owner/non-owner and viewer/editor cases passed. Every non-owner invoice request was denied and no invoice fields were returned.
